title: Chinese military reportedly uses American AI models to train its defense systems - tools from OpenAI and Anthropic…
excerpt: AI-enhanced defense systems from the East, leveraging closed-weight models from the West
content_html:
• Distillation sidesteps the logic of US export controls, which restrict the chips needed to train frontier models but cannot restrict the text those models produce
  • Review of more than 80 Chinese papers and patents found PLA-linked researchers distilling outputs from OpenAI and Anthropic models into small systems they can run locally
  • The Trump administration is increasingly critical of the approach and has claimed Chinese research lab-created Kimi K3 distilled Anthropic's Fable model

A new investigation has claimed Chinese military researchers have used outputs from American AI models built by OpenAI and Anthropic to train domestic systems intended to advance the country's defense capabilities.

The findings are based on a Reuters review of more than 80 Chinese academic papers and patents, incorporating research compiled by the Washington-based Jamestown Foundation shared exclusively with the news agency.

Reuters says it independently verified the literature and found a further two dozen military-linked case studies of its own.

A distillation problem in an AI race that continues to heat up

The mechanism at issue is model distillation, in which the outputs of a large, capable system are used as training data for a smaller one. The smaller model inherits selected behaviors at a fraction of the compute cost and, crucially, can run on modest local hardware.

That is the strategic point. Washington's export controls are built to deny China the chips needed to train frontier models. Distillation does not need those chips, because the expensive part has already been paid for by someone else. It sits alongside Beijing's other route around the controls: substituting domestic silicon for American designs, a shift that carries its own long-term threat to Nvidia and AMD.

Sunny Cheung, the Jamestown fellow who analyzed more than 60 of the papers, frames the value as reasoning rather than answers. Getting a model to produce the right output is comparatively easy, he told Reuters, but "teaching it the reasoning behind the answer is much harder."

The papers, on his reading, show Chinese military-linked researchers trying to move that expensive proprietary reasoning into small systems they can control and deploy themselves.

There is an irony in the pattern. Beijing has been moving to restrict consumer access to Western AI models on security grounds, and has pushed its own labs away from US-designed chips, even as its military researchers mine the outputs of American systems.

The asymmetry points at what is wrong with the US instrument. Export controls regulate objects: chips, tools, hardware that crosses a border and can be counted. The thing being transferred here is text a model produced- which crosses no border in any customs sense and cannot be enumerated.

The White House has registered the problem at both the chip and distillation end, but registering it is not the same as having a lever. For now, the debate over whether distillation is theft or standard practice may matter less than the fact that neither answer offers a workable control.

Rahim Amir is a UAE-based tech writer who enjoys building PCs as much as he enjoys writing about them. He has been professionally writing about PC hardware since 2023, focusing on buyer’s guides, hardware reviews, and sponsored content and features related to tech.

content_html_zh:
• 蒸馏回避了美国出口管制的逻辑，美国出口管制限制了训练前沿模型所需的芯片，但不能限制这些模型产生的文本
  • 对 80 多篇中国论文和专利的审查发现，与 PLA 相关的研究人员将 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 模型的输出提炼成可以在本地运行的小型系统
  • 特朗普政府对这种方法越来越批评，并声称中国研究实验室创建的 Kimi K3 提炼了 Anthropic 的寓言模型

一项新的调查声称，中国军事研究人员使用 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 构建的美国人工智能模型的输出来训练旨在提高国家防御能力的国内系统。

该调查结果基于路透社对 80 多篇中国学术论文和专利的审查，其中纳入了总部位于华盛顿的詹姆斯敦基金会与该通讯社独家分享的研究成果。

路透社表示，它独立核实了这些文献，并发现了另外两打与军事相关的案例研究。

持续升温的人工智能竞赛中的蒸馏问题

所讨论的机制是模型蒸馏，其中一个大型、有能力的系统的输出被用作较小系统的训练数据。 较小的模型以一小部分计算成本继承选定的行为，并且最重要的是，可以在适度的本地硬件上运行。

这就是战略要点。 华盛顿的出口管制旨在阻止中国获得训练前沿模型所需的芯片。 蒸馏不需要那些芯片，因为昂贵的部分已经被别人支付了。 它与北京围绕控制的另一条路线并行：用国产芯片替代美国设计，这一转变对英伟达和AMD带来了长期威胁。

詹姆斯敦研究员 Sunny Cheung 分析了 60 多篇论文，将其价值定义为推理而不是答案。 他告诉路透社，让模型产生正确的输出相对容易，但“教它答案背后的推理要困难得多”。

他阅读的这些论文显示，中国与军事相关的研究人员试图将昂贵的专有推理转移到他们可以自行控制和部署的小型系统中。

这种模式有一种讽刺意味。 北京一直以安全为由限制消费者使用西方人工智能模型，并迫使自己的实验室远离美国设计的芯片，尽管其军事研究人员正在挖掘美国系统的输出。

这种不对称表明了美国工具的问题所在。 出口管制管制的对象是：跨境且可计数的芯片、工具、硬件。 这里传递的东西是一个模型产生的文本——它在任何海关意义上都没有跨越国界，也无法枚举。

白宫已经在芯片和蒸馏端都记录了这个问题，但记录它并不等同于拥有杠杆。 目前，关于蒸馏是盗窃还是标准做法的争论可能比这两种答案都无法提供可行的控制这一事实更重要。

Rahim 制造了数百台游戏电脑，并且在业余时间是一名狂热的游戏玩家，他对硬件的看法往往比大多数人更强烈。 当他以强大但简约的 RGB 构建方式实现自己的方式时，这一点尤其明显，即使小型 (SFF) PC 紧随其后。
